steps.note: Start a buyer-side event that can be published and then modified.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required event line item.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event is publishable.
Add the initial participant required for publishing.
Publish the event before adding the additional participant.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Open the published stage's Participants list to add a participant after publication.
Add another available QA test vendor after publication.
Confirm the newly added participant is present and selected on the stage.
Open the stage's Order Activity drawer.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer is open.
Check that the activity content visibly refers to the participant change.
